description: The production L3 recomputation feeds production rows through the same pure core used by the endpoint. This is not the independent recomputation required by REQ-013: a shared arithmetic, deduplication, period, or reference-selection defect will reproduce the same wrong result on both sides and pass the equality check.

evidence.snippet: Feed those rows to the same pure core in a separate readback process and independently compare expected arithmetic/references to API and UI.
